ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; the visible surface is predominantly composed of low-intensity dark pixels with high-intensity white pixels occupying less than 2% of the total surface area, restricted to localized scars.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark pigmentation across the entire visible surface. Specific high-contrast white pixel clusters are mapped to the distal-lateral region of the left lobe (coordinates relative to lobe center) and minor linear traces on the distal right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: U-shaped depression with a shallow interior angle and vertical depth of approximately 1/8th of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the central-to-distal boundary of both lobes; a significant irregular indentation/notch is visible at the extreme distal-lateral edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve extending upward and outward from the median notch, transitioning to a slight taper at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-contrast circular white pixel clusters localized at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct intersecting cross-hatch pattern of white linear pixels is visible on the mid-lateral section of the left lobe; multiple fine, parallel horizontal white lines are visible near the tip of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular notch/missing tissue on the trailing edge of the left lobe tip and a prominent 'X' shaped white scar on the left lobe surface.
